node.statement: Approximate commutativity: under the root hypotheses, for all x,y in B, ||xy-yx|| <= 10K*eta*||x||*||y||. Put a=Delta x, b=Delta y, a0=Phi a, b0=Phi b. By node 1.3, ||a-a0||<=2K*eta||x|| and ||b-b0||<=2K*eta||y||; by nodes 1.1-1.2, ||a||,||a0||<=||x|| and ||b||,||b0||<=||y||, while [a0,b0]=0. Hence ||[a,b]||<=||[a-a0,b]||+||[a0,b-b0]||<=8K*eta||x||||y||. The two approximate-product hypotheses for (x,y) and (y,x), together with contractivity of Upsilon, give ||[x,y]||<=2K*eta||x||||y||+||Upsilon([a,b])||<=10K*eta||x||||y||.
